items.scope_limit: These are clinical risk and site-of-care categories after integrating several clinical variables, not a diagnostic rule for confirming PE or an automatic thrombolytic prescription; no exact D subtype assigned to the presumed PE case solely from lactate.

items.scope_limit: All three scenarios are hypothetical and illustrative rather than a validated algorithm; absence of mass does not exclude microscopic disease, ALP magnitude cannot define infiltration burden, suspected AL requires clinical pretest selection and tissue typing for confirmation.

items.locator: 2026 ASH AL light chain amyloidosis diagnostic good-practice statements compared against Figure 3-4 SPEP line
items.teaching_role: Expose the limits of SPEP, GGT and negative imaging; prevent false exclusion of AL amyloidosis from isolated negative SPEP.
items.scope_limit: SIFE/UIFE/sFLC are relevant to clinically suspected AL; these are not universal tests for isolated ALP elevation and do not replace biopsy typing.

items.locator: Doe-Williams et al. Case Reports in Gastroenterology 2020;14:271-278, PMID 32518538 original case ALP 85 IU/L vs liver biopsy specimen 95% involvement
items.teaching_role: Use a published real case with specimen-confirmed extensive AL amyloidosis and normal measured ALP to falsify the assumption that ALP scales linearly with infiltration burden; disclose sample-versus-whole-organ distinction.
items.scope_limit: Single patient is not a sensitivity estimate; biopsy 95% refers to sampled specimen rather than 95% of the entire liver; medical meaning and typing require original pathologic context.
